title: Design Arena turns millions of user choices into AI model rankings
friendlyTitle: Design Arena helps people compare creative AI models
summary: Design Arena lets people compare model outputs for websites, slides, apps, games, images, video and other formats, then publishes preference-based leaderboards. The service says more than 5.5 million users across over 190 countries use it to compare creative AI systems.
friendlySummary: You ask several AI models to make the same thing, compare their answers and vote for the best one.
whyItMatters: Benchmarks often miss whether an output is actually useful or appealing. Side-by-side human preference data can help users choose a model for a specific creative task and give model makers feedback grounded in real work.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help you pick the right AI for design work instead of trusting one general score.
